mapper.select: SELECT client_user_id, expo_id, expo_title, sales_date, paid_order_count, canceled_order_count, sold_ticket_quantity, refund_ticket_quantity, ticket_sales_amount, booking_fee_amount, refund_ticket_amount, refund_booking_fee_amount, buyer_payment_amount, client_settlement_base_amount, calculated_at FROM v_client_dashboard_daily_sales WHERE client_user_id = #{clientUserId} AND expo_id = #{expoId} ORDER BY sales_date ASC

SELECT host_client_id, settlement_id, expo_id, expo_title, event_end_at, settlement_due_at, status, gross_ticket_sales_amount, ticket_refund_amount, net_ticket_sales_amount, booking_fee_gross_amount, booking_fee_refund_amount, booking_fee_net_amount, gross_booth_sales_amount, adjustment_amount, remittance_due_amount, remitted_amount, remitted_at, remittance_status, latest_report_file_id, latest_report_format, latest_report_version FROM v_client_dashboard_settlements WHERE host_client_id = #{hostClientId} ORDER BY settlement_due_at DESC
